MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

2. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 38
   D. 30

5. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

8. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 9

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 44
   D. 15

11. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
